# BTicino C300X Integration v1.7.4

## Added

- Add SIP server readiness diagnostics so media readiness can report local SIP
  server problems more clearly.

## Fixed

- Fix Android and iOS Ring Call notification **Answer** actions so answering
  opens the configured Home Assistant dashboard in the Companion App.
- Show the unprovisioned smartphone forwarding state as a read-only status.

## Upgrade Notes

- Restart Home Assistant after updating.
- Update the native C300X device agent from Home Assistant to `1.7.4`.
